metadata.name: buddy_distributor
metadata.description: Four-bucket community distributor for the Buddy relaunch

accounts.name: receipt
docs: Existence of this account is the double-claim guard: `init` fails if a
receipt for this wallet is already on chain.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone may relay the transaction — the signature itself is the
authorisation, and it is bound to `destination_owner`.

instructions.name: claim_rewards
docs: Withdraw settled base rewards. Always available, every tier.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The Squads multisig (or whatever key the community agrees on) that may
fund buckets before the lock. It has no power at all afterwards.

accounts.name: vault
docs: Single token vault holding every bucket's tokens plus all staked
principal. Bucket balances are tracked in `Config`; the vault is the
physical custody account.

accounts.name: sol_vault
docs: Program-owned PDA holding SOL rewards (routed creator fees, donations).

instructions.name: lock_config
docs: Freeze every claim parameter. After this the authority cannot change
allocations, roots, deadlines or the signer key.

instructions.name: withdraw_boost_escrow
docs: Withdraw the boost portion. Only at lock maturity.

types.name: ClaimReceipt
docs: One-shot marker proving a wallet already claimed from a Merkle bucket.
Its existence *is* the double-claim guard — `init` fails if it is present.

types.name: Config
docs: Global configuration and the accounting for buckets 2, 3 and 4.
Everything in here that governs a claim is written once at `initialize` and
frozen by `lock_config`. After the lock, the authority can no longer change
allocations, roots, deadlines or the signer key — the only remaining admin
surface is emergency-free. This is what makes the published pre-commitment
document binding rather than aspirational.

fields.name: locked
docs: Set true by `lock_config`. Once true, no field below may change.

fields.name: claims_start
docs: Timestamp at which claim windows begin counting.

fields.name: original_signer_pubkey
docs: Uncompressed secp256k1 public key as X||Y (the 65-byte form with the
leading 0x04 stripped), exactly as `secp256k1_recover` returns it.

fields.name: old_holder_root
docs: Merkle root over (wallet, amount) for old Buddy holders.

fields.name: influencer_root
docs: Merkle root over (wallet, amount) for the published influencer list.

fields.name: original_signer_pubkey
docs: Uncompressed secp256k1 key from the 2014 transaction, X||Y, 0x04 stripped.

fields.name: dev_cliff_seconds
docs: Seconds after `claims_start` before the dev stream begins releasing.

fields.name: claims_start
docs: When claim windows begin. Pass 0 to use the current block time.

types.name: SolVault
docs: Holds SOL rewards (routed creator fees, donations).
Deliberately owned by this program rather than the System Program: only the
owning program may debit an account's lamports directly, and paying stakers
out of a system-owned PDA would need a CPI on every single claim.

types.name: StakePool
docs: Bucket 1 — the community staking pool.
Rewards arrive here from three sources: the routed share of pump.fun creator
fees, voluntary donations, and every forfeiture in the system (expired
buckets, slashed principal, abandoned boost escrow). Distribution uses the
standard rewards-per-share accumulator so that paying N stakers costs O(1).

fields.name: total_weight
docs: Sum of every position's weight (amount x tier multiplier).

fields.name: total_staked
docs: Sum of every position's principal, unweighted.

fields.name: acc_token_per_weight
docs: Cumulative token rewards per unit of weight, scaled by ACC_PRECISION.

fields.name: acc_sol_per_weight
docs: Cumulative SOL rewards per unit of weight, scaled by ACC_PRECISION.

fields.name: pending_token_rewards
docs: Rewards that arrived while `total_weight == 0`. Held here rather than
dropped, and folded into the accumulator on the next notify once real
stakers exist.

fields.name: lifetime_token_rewards
docs: Lifetime totals, for the public dashboard.

types.name: StakePosition
docs: One staker's position.
The base/boost split lives here. Rewards accrue on `weight` (amount x tier
multiplier), but only the portion attributable to `amount x 1.0` is
immediately claimable. The remainder — the part the multiplier bought — is
escrowed until the lock matures, and is forfeited on early exit. Without
this, a staker could take the 3.0x rate, claim continuously, and leave after
a few weeks having honoured none of the commitment the multiplier paid for.

fields.name: lock_end
docs: Timestamp at which a locked tier matures. Zero for flexible.

fields.name: unstake_requested_at
docs: Timestamp of an unstake request for a flexible position; zero if none.

fields.name: token_debt
docs: Accumulator checkpoints — rewards already accounted for.

fields.name: claimable_token
docs: Settled base rewards, withdrawable at any time.

fields.name: escrow_token
docs: Settled boost rewards, withdrawable only at lock maturity.

types.name: Stream
docs: Linear vesting stream used by bucket 3 (influencers, 30 days) and bucket 4
(founders, 12 months with an optional cliff).

fields.name: cliff
docs: Nothing is withdrawable before this timestamp. Equal to `start` when
there is no cliff.
